coverage_notes: No recovered anchors were supplied. The target paragraphs impose indemnity, claims-procedure, payment, tax, and invoice-dispute duties, but the fixed activity vocabulary has no faithful activity for indemnifying/defending/holding harmless, paying the provider, sending the specified notices, cooperating in claims, or consenting to settlements. Charge is not applicable because it denotes charging third parties. No placeholder Use clauses are created.

paragraph_audit.reason: Lines 87–89 require Mistral AI to indemnify, defend, and hold Customer harmless against qualifying third-party intellectual-property claims, subject to the exclusions in Section 8.2. These are operative obligations but do not fit an allowed activity.

Line 91 requires Customer to indemnify, defend, and hold Mistral AI and specified related parties harmless for claims arising from the stated causes. These are operative obligations but do not fit an allowed activity.

Line 93 imposes claims-procedure duties: prompt written notice, exclusive defense/control rights, cooperation and assistance, and prior written consent for specified settlements. These procedural actions do not fit an allowed activity.

Line 105 requires Customer to pay provider fees within 30 days after invoice unless an Order Form provides otherwise; Customer Account fees are automatically charged monthly as provided in the applicable order terms. The paid amounts are non-refundable, non-cancellable, and non-creditable. Provider payment is not Charge, which means charging third parties, and the remaining payment terms have no faithful allowed activity.

Line 107 assigns Customer tax-payment and remittance duties, prohibits tax-related deductions, provides an exception for a promptly supplied valid exemption certificate, and requires a payment increase when legally required withholding would otherwise reduce Mistral AI’s receipt of the agreed fees. These payment and remittance actions do not fit an allowed activity.

Line 109 requires Customer to pay undisputed fees and, within 15 days of invoice issuance, notify Mistral AI of a good-faith dispute with sufficient detail. Payment and notice actions do not fit an allowed activity.
